cues: Some verbs have no passive at all.
Intransitive verbs with no object: come, go, die, happen, occur.
Stative verbs: have meaning own, resemble, lack, suit, cost.
And reflexive objects: he hurt himself.
So the accident was happened is wrong: the accident happened.
And this shirt is suited you: this shirt suits you.
